english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for playful behaviour intended to annoy or cause minor trouble, especially a prank.
Use this for a prank or practical joke rather than a financial scam.
Use 惡作劇 when the lark is specifically a prank or practical joke.

examples.english: Those kids are always up to mischief, keeping everyone in the house awake.
examples.traditional: 班細路成日搞惡作劇，搞到成屋人都瞓唔着。
examples.jyutping: baan1 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 gaau2 ok3 zok3 kek6 gaau2 dou3 seng4 uk1 jan4 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6

examples.english: Their fake cockroach prank was a really over-the-top humbug.
examples.traditional: 佢哋喺我張枱度放咗隻假蟑螂，真係過分嘅惡作劇。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 ngo5 zoeng1 ci4 dou6 fong3 zo2 zek3 gaa2 zoeng1 long4 zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6 ge3 ok3 zok3 kek6

examples.english: The lark we pulled on Ming yesterday had him completely fooled.
examples.traditional: 我哋尋日整咗個惡作劇，呃到阿明一愣一愣。
